default.description_en:
This dataset provides official, curated German federal state boundaries (Länder / Bundesländer) for the latest year, maintained as part of the Huwise Geographical Reference Repository (Georef).

Key Use Cases

  • Spatial Joins & Regional Geocoding: Easily cross-reference your geographic data points (latitude/longitude) to determine which of the 16 federal states (Länder) they belong to.
  • High-Level Data Enrichment: Contains official names and unique identifiers (such as lan_code) to clean up, group, or aggregate national macroeconomic and sales data at the state level.

Enhancements & Data Quality

Unlike raw geographic data, this dataset has been specifically optimized for web performance and data consistency:

  • Enriched Identifiers: Added ISO 3166-3 Area codes to guarantee seamless international data compliance.
  • Performance Optimized: Geometries have been intelligently simplified to ensure fast loading times and high performance across all web services and API calls, without losing geographical relevance.

Data Source

Source data extracted from the yearly Verwaltungsgebiete 1:250 000 (VG250) series published by the Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG) and enhanced by Huwise.
